book.title: 今天不是生日呀
book.subtitle: 一个普通下午的藏宝图

moral.zh: 惊喜不是表现完美的奖励，而是妈妈一直把你放在心上的悄悄告白；普通的日子，也可以因为爱而闪闪发光。
moral.en: A surprise is not a reward for being perfect; it is Mom’s quiet way of saying she sees your effort and loves you every single day.

pages.enText: There was no red circle on the calendar; today was neither Children's Day nor An'an's birthday. Home after school, An'an built a block bridge on the rug while Mom sliced juicy sweet oranges in the kitchen.

pages.zhText: 安安忽然坐直身子，抓起桌上的彩色铅笔，在手账本的第二页上画了一个大大的爱心，中间画着两个人紧紧牵手：“妈妈，这个本子是我们的悄悄话本，我也送你一朵永远不凋谢的红花！”
pages.enText: An'an suddenly sat straight, grabbed colored pencils from the table, and drew a big red heart on the journal's second page with two stick figures holding hands. “Mom, this is our whisper book. Here is an eternal flower for you, too!”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Desk view: An'an leans over the little blank journal drawing a vibrant red crayon flower and heart; Mom watches closely beside her, touched and beaming.

pages.enText: Golden twilight crept across the dinner table. Mother and daughter shared sweet orange slices together, the citrus aroma filling the room while soft streetlamps blinked on outside.

pages.zhText: 睡前，安安在墙上的大日历里，给今天的“星期二”旁边认真画了一颗金黄色的小太阳。原来，不用等大大的节日，只要用心相爱，每一个普通的日子都能拆出闪闪发光的惊喜。
pages.enText: At bedtime, An'an drew a bright golden sun beside today's Tuesday on the wall calendar. It turns out you never have to wait for a big holiday; whenever love is shared, any ordinary day can unwrap a shining surprise.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Cozy bedtime bedroom: warm soft nightlight glow; An'an in pale yellow pajamas stands by the calendar adding a little golden sun beside Tuesday; peaceful happy smile.

parentGuide.goal: 引导孩子理解“被关注与被爱”不取决于分数或特定节日仪式；体会家人之间细致入微的观察与陪伴，培养孩子表达感恩与爱的双向情感能力。
parentGuide.reminder: 送孩子惊喜时，不妨强调“我看到了你某件具体的努力”而非空洞的表扬，让礼物成为成长的温情见证；接纳孩子用图画、小拥抱等方式给予家人的爱心回馈。
questions: 安安找到礼物的三个线索，分别藏在哪里？
妈妈送安安的礼物是什么？为什么安安觉得比买来的大玩具还宝贝？
parentGuide.activity: 在家里设置一个“家庭悄悄话信箱”，放一个闲置的小盒子在客厅，家庭成员可以在任何平凡的一天塞进画或纸条，给彼此创造小惊喜。

ageTips.age4to5: 引导孩子观察图画中的寻宝线索，体会收到礼物的惊喜与开心；鼓励孩子用拥抱或画画回应妈妈的爱。
ageTips.age6to8: 讨论为什么普通日子也会有礼物，引导孩子认识到自己的成长与自理一直被父母看在眼里；建立双向感恩与表达爱的习惯。
